about: One approved migrate unit (count line to idea-mara), plus three changes no record explains, written with the migrator's notes: a changed line in the Brain Dump doc (the ferry line), an added line in idea-mara (the cat), and a removed line in idea-tobias (his father). The real Edit guard raises unexplained-change on each, with no unit. `act` at pointed sends them to the migration-verifier (verify-flags.json: the three flags, units {}). All three are judged not asked for. `act` at judged restores each: the ferry line goes back to its before text, the cat line is removed, and the father line goes back under the nearest non-blank line above it in the snapshot, Tobias's ferry job. u1 stays pointer-written. The step is acted, next_check 2, and the second check comes back [].
spec: CONTRACT.md 4 item 11 (putting back a removed line)
readings: verify-flags.json's units is {} when no flag names a unit.
Restoring lines isn't an undo, so `act` writes no undo-misses.json here.
